conservation.condition_narrative: "Sprayed with butyl methacrylate polymer, March, 1948, by Keck" (Keck typed label).
conservation.report_notes: Published with corresponding artwork entry in *Georgia O’Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné* (Lynes, 1999), this historical conservation information documents treatment decisions made during the artist’s lifetime. Lynes quotes information found on backing labels, and, when noted, from other sources.

cr_data.provenance: (Jean Seth, Santa Fe, NM); (Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Doris Bry [1920-2014], New York, NY; to Private Collection, Dallas, TX, 1975; given to Private Collection, St. Petersburg, FL, 1996; to (Menconi & Schoelkopf Fine Art, LLC, New York, NY); purchased by Art Bridges, TX, 2021 (Source: Art Bridges website, 2026)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946. . . . On backing: Written by Andrew, 'A Piece of Wood 12'" [not verified]. "II" on Downtown Gallery label title written in by Doris Bry, black ink. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
